summary: Configures a sound-buffer / D3D-context object from a parameter block. Initializes two local helper objects, guards that a1, a4 and a9 are all non-null (otherwise returns the failure code -2005530516), defaults a10 to 524292 when it is -1, prepares a descriptor via sub_506971, fills a configuration record from a4..a7 with two 24-byte copies of a9 plus a8/a11, initializes the D3D context via D3DContextInit, then tears both helper objects down and returns 0 on success or the propagated setup error.

Proceed only when a1, a4 and a9 are all non-null; otherwise set the result to the failure code -2005530516 and skip the setup body.
Default the a10 parameter to 524292 when it equals -1.
Prepare the context descriptor v14 via sub_506971(v14, a1, a2, a3, 0, 0); a negative result jumps straight to the cleanup path.
Fill the configuration record v15 with a4, a5, a6, a7, copy a9 into two 24-byte payload blocks, and store a11 and a8 into the following words.
Initialize the D3D context via D3DContextInit(v14, v15, a10); on success the result is 0, on failure the negative setup error is propagated.
Tear down both helper objects on every exit path: ThunkToFUN0050653e(v21) followed by DualVTableDestructor(v20).
Return 0 on success, the propagated setup error on failure, or -2005530516 when an input argument was null.
